About the game

The Assur Caravan

Introduction

The Assur Caravan is a classroom trading game set in 1895 BCE. Begin in Assur with borrowed silver, choose a cargo of tin and textiles, and trade in the markets of Anatolia.

Plan your route, compare prices and costs, and decide when to send your earnings home. Your goal is to finish the trading season with the highest profit secured in Assur.

History

The game was originally designed by Gojko Barjamovic for Beginnings of Business, a course taught at Harvard. It has since been revised and used in classes at Harvard and Yale. In 2026, Gojko Barjamovic and Yunhao Li developed the design further and adapted it for online play with assistance from ChatGPT.

Past winners

The team of Lucatony Angel Valencia won the Fall 2026 classroom competition in Yale's Beginnings of Business course, earning a combined profit of 25,765.88 shekels of silver across two runs.
